rtpc_system.description: Real-time parameter control for dynamic audio

parameters.name: DistanceToWaterfall
parameters.purpose: Controls waterfall volume and filtering based on player distance

implementation.code:
float distance = Vector3.Distance(playerListener.position, transform.position);
AkSoundEngine.SetRTPCValue(rtpcName, distance, gameObject);
implementation.wwise_behavior:
In Wwise, waterfall blend container uses this RTPC to crossfade between Close/Mid/Far layers:
- Close layer (Splashes_Close 130KB): loud when distance < 10
- Mid layer (Main_Mid 6.3MB): active at medium distances
- Far layer (Rumbling_Far 3.6MB): distant rumble when far away
Total waterfall assets: ~10MB for layered distance-based mixing

parameters.optimization: Continuous distance updates keep audio responsive without manual triggers. RTPC crossfading in Wwise is CPU-efficient

implementation.purpose: Spawns audio events at random positions within defined 3D volume
parameters: areaCenter: Vector3 - center of spawn volume
eventName: string - Wwise event to trigger
minInterval/maxInterval: float - random time range between spawns
implementation.code_flow:
1. Timer counts down random interval
2. Calculate random position in volume
3. Create temporary GameObject at position
4. Register with Wwise and post event
5. Destroy temp object after 10 seconds
implementation.optimization: Temporary GameObjects cleaned up automatically, prevents memory leaks from positioned one-shots

waterfall_system_detailed.description: Complex distance-based waterfall mixing using RTPC

layers.name: Main_Mid
layers.behavior: Primary waterfall sound at medium distances

layers.name: Rumbling_Far
layers.behavior: Distant rumble when far from waterfall
layers.frequency: Low frequency rumble with filtered highs

implementation_flow: 2. Posts distance value to Wwise via SetRTPCValue()
3. Wwise blend container crossfades between Close/Mid/Far based on RTPC value
4. Smooth transitions create realistic distance-based mixing
waterfall_system_detailed.wwise_configuration: In Wwise, blend container uses DistanceToWaterfall RTPC with crossfade points at specific distance thresholds (likely 0-10 = Close, 10-50 = Mid, 50+ = Far)
waterfall_system_detailed.optimization: Real-time RTPC updates are CPU-efficient. Crossfading done in Wwise audio thread. Large file sizes justified by being core Stomach zone feature.
waterfall_system_detailed.artistic_intent: Creates convincing waterfall that responds naturally to player movement - close = splashy detail, far = distant rumble

strengths: Clean separation: BNK_Init/General for global sounds, per-zone banks for ambiences
Smart use of Wwise features: States for zone switching, Switches for footsteps, RTPC for waterfall
Explicit cleanup: Loop IDs stored and stopped to prevent orphaned audio
Platform scalability: Android_Low profile for budget devices
Memory-conscious: Streaming music, Silence plugin, zone-based loading
CPU-friendly: Wwise handles randomization/crossfading, minimal scripting overhead
Spatial design: AudibleBounds volumes reduce per-frame calculations
areas_marked_for_improvement: Death audio uses temporary GameObjects (commented as 'dirty solution')
Could integrate PoolSystem for audio GameObjects instead of creating/destroying
Some scripts like GroundTargetMover.cs are empty stubs

conclusion.summary: Sophisticated multi-platform Wwise implementation with zone-based loading, dynamic waterfall RTPC system, layered ambient design, and careful optimization for mobile. Uses Wwise's built-in features (States, Switches, RTPCs, Silence plugin, streaming) to minimize scripting complexity while maintaining rich audio experience.
conclusion.key_innovation: Distance-based waterfall RTPC creates dynamic spatial audio, zone-based State system enables memory-efficient ambient streaming
